Governo.titolo: Fondo unico per l’inclusione delle persone con disabilità
Governo.descrizione: Criteri e modalità di riparto del Fondo unico per l’inclusione delle persone con disabilità ai fini, per l’anno 2026, di cui all’articolo 1, comma 213, lettera f), della legge 30 dicembre 2023, n. 213: interventi finalizzati al riconoscimento del valore sociale ed economico dell’attività di cura non professionale del caregiver familiare.

Governo.titolo: Incidente ferroviario in Spagna, dichiarazione del Presidente Meloni
Governo.descrizione: In queste ore così difficili, il Governo italiano è vicino alla Spagna e al popolo spagnolo per il drammatico incidente ferroviario avvenuto nei pressi di Toledo. I miei pensieri e quelli di tutto il nostro Governo vanno ai familiari delle vittime, ai feriti e a quanti stanno lavorando senza sosta nelle operazioni di soccorso.

Governo.titolo: Il Presidente Meloni all’Assemblea di Confartigianato
Governo.descrizione: Il Presidente del Consiglio, Giorgia Meloni, ha tenuto un intervento all’Assemblea di Confartigianato, presso l’Auditorium della Conciliazione di Roma.

Governo.titolo: Piano Mattei per l'Africa, la tratta zambiana della nuova ferrovia del Corridoio di Lobito a guida italiana: la nota di Palazzo Chigi
Governo.descrizione: Il Piano Mattei per l'Africa porta l'Italia alla guida di una delle infrastrutture più strategiche del continente africano. Africa Finance Corporation ha nominato Webuild preferred bidder per la tratta zambiana della nuova ferrovia del Corridoio di Lobito. L'impresa italiana guiderà un consorzio internazionale con la portoghese Mota-Engil e la turca İçtaş, scelto al termine di una gara internazion

Governo.titolo: Dichiarazione del Presidente del Consiglio, Giorgia Meloni
Governo.descrizione: Mi congratulo con il Presidente Lula per la rielezione e con il popolo brasiliano per la straordinaria prova di partecipazione elettorale. Italia e Brasile continueranno a lavorare insieme sui principali dossier bilaterali e sulle tante sfide comuni che ci attendono, nello spirito di amicizia che unisce i nostri popoli.

Governo.titolo: ECAD, Incontro internazionale sulla prevenzione e il recupero dalle dipendenze, le conclusioni del Sottosegretario Mantovano
Governo.descrizione: L'intervento conclusivo del Sottosegretario alla Presidenza del Consiglio, Alfredo Mantovano, all'Incontro internazionale di alto livello sulla prevenzione e il recupero dalle dipendenze, tenutosi a San Patrignano.

Governo.titolo: Progressioni verticali 2025, esiti della valutazione dei titoli e calendario della prova orale
Governo.descrizione: Avviso ai candidati relativi alla procedura di selezione indetta con decreto del Segretario Generale del 10 dicembre 2025 per il passaggio dalla Categoria “B” al parametro retributivo iniziale della Categoria “A” per 27 unità riservato al personale appartenente al ruolo non dirigenziale della Presidenza del Consiglio dei Ministri.

Governo.titolo: Incontro bilaterale con l'Emiro del Kuwait
Governo.descrizione: Il Presidente del Consiglio, Giorgia Meloni, ha incontrato in Kuwait l’Emiro Sheikh Misha’al Al-Ahmed Al-Jaber Al-Sabah, alla presenza del Principe Ereditario e del Primo Ministro, per approfondire la cooperazione bilaterale, con particolare riferimento agli investimenti, all’energia, alle infrastrutture e alla difesa. Commissione, notizie.titolo: Bavarian carp ponds: cultural heritage at the water’s edge
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: In Bavaria, traditional carp pond farming is not just a way of producing fish. It is a living cultural landscape, recognised as intangible cultural heritage in Germany since 2021. The Karpfenland Aischgrund e.V. project helped bring it into the spotlight,

Commissione, notizie.titolo: EU launches Friends of Credits for Nature and Biodiversity at COP17
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The initiative aims to build international support for nature credits and strengthen cooperation on biodiversity finance.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commission launches High-Level Dialogue with the European oil refining sector
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The European Commission launched today the first High-Level Dialogue with the European oil refining industry to discuss how to strengthen Europe’s energy security, defence readiness and industrial competitiveness in a rapidly changing geopolitical environment.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: PESPod #29: Beyond the classroom: lessons from Sweden's Samstart and Samstart+
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The latest episode of PESPod, the podcast of the European Network of Public Employment Services (PES Network), explores how the Swedish Public Employment Service is helping young people with disabilities or health conditions through the transition from education into employment.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: New Study on Law Enforcement Training in the EU
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The European Commission published the Feasibility Study on Law Enforcement Training in the EU – the first comprehensive overview of training for law enforcement across the EU since 2013.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commission proposes a stronger Frontex:   more resources, a greater role on returns and effective crisis response
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: On 27 October, the European Commission proposed to further strengthen Frontex, turning it into the EU’s central actor for protecting external borders and organising returns across the Union. The Commission has also proposed a Regulation to digitalise return, readmission and reintegration.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: EU research and innovation support Europe’s new Framework for Climate Resilience
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: From understanding climate risks to developing and demonstrating innovative solutions, EU-funded research and innovation is helping Europe strengthen its climate preparedness, protecting people, preserving critical assets, and safeguarding the continent’s competitiveness and prosperity.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Joint Implementation Dialogue on Improving the Competitiveness of the Trans-Caspian Transport Corridor
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: On 17 November 2026, Commissioners Marta Kos and Jozef Síkela will chair an Implementation Dialogue on Improving the Competitiveness of the Trans-Caspian Transport Corridor, bringing together the private sector, IFIs and the Commission to discuss support for strategic investment and competitiveness.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Road safety statistics for 2025 confirm drop in EU road deaths
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The Commission released the final figures on road fatalities for 2025, reporting 19,350 deaths due to road crashes.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: EU gas storage is 75% filled
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: In summer 2026, disruptions to liquefied natural gas (LNG) flows linked to the conflict in the Middle East, low gas storage levels after winter 2025-2026 and slower refilling contributed to tighter supply and pushed the EU’s gas prices higher.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commission launches T-MED Investment Platform with up to €4.5 billion in EU guarantees
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Today, the European Commission launched the T-MED Investment Platform, to mobilise large-scale investment in renewable energy and clean technologies across the Mediterranean.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commission and UNEP reaffirm commitment to global environmental action and multilateralism
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: An amendment to a Memorandum of Understanding between the two sides was signed at the biennial UN Biodiversity Conference in Armenia.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Polluting ‘forever chemicals’ build up differently across continents, finds study of global freshwater reservoirs
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Freshwater reservoirs are contaminated by persistent ‘forever chemicals’. A new study reveals how chemicals build up in these water bodies, finding three key patterns of contamination based on chemical type, source, and history of use.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Plants and microbes pair up to remove pollutants from wastewater in human-made wetlands
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Microbes work to break down pollutants in constructed wetlands: a sustainable, nature-based solution for wastewater treatment. Enhancing these mechanisms to increase efficiency is possible, finds a new review, further research is needed.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Environmental protection in upcoming pharmaceutical legislation could enhance risk assessments and support implementation
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Pharmaceuticals entering the natural environment may harm ecosystems and human health. This review assesses current and future legislation designed to mitigate this risk, in light of current science.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Global Bioeconomy Summit 2026 & International Bioeconomy Forum position the bioeconomy as a paradigm for the post-2030 development agenda
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The Summit and the Forum showcase the growing global momentum behind the bioeconomy.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Agreement reached on 2027 fishing opportunities for the Baltic Sea
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The Council of the European Union reached a political agreement on the fishing opportunities in the Baltic Sea for 2027, following the Commission proposal made in August this year.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: EU-Central Asia Innovation Forum: join the discussion online on 28 October
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Researchers, innovators and companies from Europe and Central Asia meet in Tashkent on 28 October to explore new cooperation. Join online!

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Reinforcing Frontex for stronger protection of the EU’s external borders
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The Commission has proposed to reinforce Frontex, the EU agency that plays a crucial role in supporting EU and Schengen countries in managing the EU’s external borders.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Protecting Europe with stronger climate-resilience
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The EU's proactive and systemic risk management approach to protect Europeans and the EU economy from the impacts of climate change.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: AU–EU partnership opens new pathways for cooperation on AI in Science
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Artificial intelligence (AI) is opening new possibilities for scientific discovery, from improving disease diagnosis and climate predictions to strengthening food security and accelerating innovation.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: New European Master’s in Translation (EMT) competence framework reflects how AI is changing translation
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Discover the new European Master’s in Translation (EMT) competence framework, reflecting how AI and language technologies are reshaping the translation profession. It can help universities to prepare future translators to work critically, ethically and effectively in a changing industry.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Deployment of NCTS Phase 6 – Next step in the modernization of customs and transit procedures
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The rollout of Phase 6 of the New Computerised Transit System (NCTS), now in use across the 27 EU Member States and the countries of the Common Transit Convention, marks a major step forward in the digital modernisation of customs and transit procedures across 41 participating countries.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Hydrogen Strategy – Commission launches consultation
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The European Commission has today launched a 4-week call for evidence and a 4-week targeted stakeholder consultation to gather input to help shape the forthcoming Hydrogen Strategy.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Ukraine Mine Action Conference 2026: clearing the way in partnership
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The Ukraine Mine Action Conference (UMAC) is a key international initiative to advance humanitarian mine action in Ukraine, which is an essential part of Ukraine’s recovery, security and resilience.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: CEF Energy 2026 call for PCI/PMI projects attracts strong interest with 67 applications requesting €2.88 billion
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The Commission has received 67 applications for cross-border energy infrastructure projects requesting €2.88 billion in EU co-funding under the Connecting Europe Facility (CEF) Energy programme.

Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Auction results EU-Bonds

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commission launches T-MED Investment Platform with up to €4.5 billion in EU guarantees
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Today, the European Commission launched the T-MED Investment Platform, to mobilise large-scale investment in renewable energy and clean technologies across the Mediterranean. The platform is a key component of the Trans-Mediterranean Renewable Energy and Clean Tech Cooperation Initiative (T-MED)...

Commissione, notizie.titolo: EU announces an additional €22.5 million to reinforce humanitarian assistance in Yemen
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The European Commission is releasing €22.5 million in humanitarian aid to Yemen, in addition to the €87.5 million previously allocated for 2026, to address the consequences of the renewed conflict escalation and the critical needs of millions of people affected by the protracted crisis.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commission opens investigation into possible anticompetitive conduct by Omya in the supply of calcium carbonates to the paper industry
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The European Commission has opened a formal antitrust investigation to assess whether Omya has breached EU competition rules by requiring customers in the paper industry to purchase all or most of their calcium carbonates from Omya.
